query:
SELECT pm.plant_id, p.name as plant_name, pm.molecule_id, m.name as molecule_name, pm.percentage, pm.role 
FROM plant_molecules pm 
JOIN plants p ON pm.plant_id = p.id 
JOIN molecules m ON pm.molecule_id = m.id 
WHERE p.latin_name = 'Erythroxylum coca var. ipadu';
